about: What each product is, for matching by meaning: product_type (what a recipe calls it), taxonomy [department, aisle, product_type], form, variant, culinary_role and the diets it suits, from Gemini in batches (scripts/matching_seeds.py profiles); aka, the other names the catalog description gives it in parentheses. profile_text is templated from those fields and is what gets embedded, as a document titled with its product_type. flags are a second, separate Gemini pass's disagreements, for review; fixes are corrections made by hand after review (field, from, to, why). The catalog's dietary_tags (contains-tags) are never changed here. hash: the product row the profile was made from.
